query:
SELECT venue, schedule_day, schedule_time, training_date, COUNT(*) as count 
FROM training_schedules 
GROUP BY venue, schedule_day, schedule_time, training_date 
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 
ORDER BY training_date 
LIMIT 20;
